<thought>To find a suitable retrosynthetic template for the Peterson reaction, I will search the template catalog for reactions where an alkene is broken and a ketone and a trimethylsilyl group are formed in the forward direction.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["alkene"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["ketone", "trimethylsilyl"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
